mapper.sql: t.id, t.task_name, t.task_bean, t.task_params, t.task_cron, t.task_status, t.remark, t.update_time, t.create_time, t.task_type, t.url, t.exe_path, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(d.pre_task_id ORDER BY d.pre_task_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = t.id ) AS depend_id, t.username, t.password, t.driver, t.period, t.task_system, t.theme, t.offset, t.job_key, t.notification_failed, t.notification_completed
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_quartz_task t WHERE t.task_status = 0 ORDER BY t.id
SELECT FROM t_quartz_task t INNER JOIN t_quartz_task_dependency d ON d.task_id = t.id WHERE d.pre_task_id = #{id}
SELECT pre_task_id FROM t_quartz_task_dependency WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id

SELECT , ws.data_date AS dataDate FROM t_quartz_task_status ws INNER JOIN t_quartz_task t ON t.id = ws.plan_id WHERE ws.status = 1 AND t.task_status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_quartz_task_dependency d WHERE d.task_id = ws.plan_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_quartz_task_status ds WHERE ds.plan_id = d.pre_task_id AND ds.data_date = ws.data_date AND ds.status = 3 ) ) ORDER BY ws.id
